caveats.finding: In the authors' archive the LaTeX \label commands are swapped: pmo_comparison_table_with_std_no_prescreen.tex carries \label{tab:prescreen} and pmo_comparison_table_with_std.tex carries \label{tab:no_prescreen}. Keying off the label inverts the regime. The authority is the COLUMN HEADER ('InVirtuoGen (no prescreen)' vs 'InVirtuoGen') and the caption, which are unambiguous and agree with the results directory names and with the README.

caveats.evidence: MEASURED code read; INFERRED numerical equivalence
caveats.finding: The auc_top10 column in the published per-run CSVs is written by PBOptimizer.save_result_tot, which calls top_auc(..., finish=False, ...). It is called immediately after log_intermediate(finish=True) at the end of a run, and the run either exits because len(mol_buffer) >= max_oracle_calls or pads mol_buffer with zero-score entries up to max_oracle_calls on early stop. With a full buffer the finish term is inactive and finish=False equals finish=True, and zero-score padding does not change the running top-10 mean, so the padded trapezoids equal the flat finish=True extension. The equality is argued from the code, not observed by re-running; the buffer can also slightly overshoot 10,000, in which case top_auc divides by len(buffer). Treat the registry metric as top_auc(top_n=10, finish=True) at 10,000 calls, which is how the authors describe it.

caveats.evidence: MEASURED for GenMol; INFERRED for InVirtuoGen
caveats.finding: The InVirtuoGen prescreen reads in_virtuo_reinforce/vocab/zinc250k.csv, sorts by a PRE-COMPUTED per-task oracle column, and injects the top rows with their scores already attached, bypassing self.oracle() and therefore mol_buffer. That path is MEASURED from the archive source. The exact number of prescreen oracle calls is NOT measurable from the archive because in_virtuo_reinforce/vocab is gitignored and absent. The ~249,455 figure is the measured ZINC250k size from the repo's own GenMol audit (docs/AMENDMENT_PMO_PRESCREEN_AUDIT.md) applied to the same dataset, and is therefore INFERRED for InVirtuoGen.

The archive pins pytdc==1.1.15, rdkit==2023.9.6, scikit_learn==1.2.2. Completed COMPOSE PMO development waves used PyTDC 0.3.6 and RDKit 2024.03.5 (docs/PMO_IVG_ORACLE_PARITY.md). drd2, gsk3b and jnk3 are downloaded-predictor oracles whose shipped assets changed between those versions, so even a budget-matched, regime-matched comparison on those three tasks carries an oracle-version caveat. gsk3b is one of the three pinned pilot tasks.

Gen. GFN / Mol GA / REINVENT / Graph GA no-prescreen columns are transcriptions by InVirtuoGen from other publications; no raw per-run data for them exists in the archive. They are recorded at tier SECOND_HAND and must not be promoted to the same evidential tier as the InVirtuoGen column.

Published Sum cells are computed from unrounded run means: no-prescreen 16.676 vs 16.674 as the sum of the rounded per-task cells; prescreened 18.993 vs 18.992. This is rounding, not an inconsistency. Sum a column from the unrounded means, or state which you used.
No network access was used. Every value is derived from an archive already present on this machine whose sha256 was already recorded in this repository.
